prBodyNotes: **Before promoting:** run `deerlab-backup-vikunja.service` by hand and confirm `Result=success`. Vikunja migrates its schema on every start; the only rollback is a restore. See docs/runbook.md, Vikunja, Upgrading.
**No downgrade path.** Once promoted, reverting this PR leaves an image older than `configured_version`, which refuses to start. Pin forward, never back.
